connector.summary: Hosted at api.cg3.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package prior-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.cg3. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
